description: Korean Personal Information Protection Act helper for businesses. mode=breach (default): from the time a leak (incl. loss or theft) became known, returns the 72-hour deadline to notify data subjects (제34조①, 시행령 제39조; hours, not moved for holidays), whether a report to PIPC or KISA is also required within 72 hours (1,000+ people, sensitive or unique identifiers, or unlawful external access such as hacking; 시행령 제40조), the five required notice items and ordered steps (30-day website posting when contacts are unknown). mode=policy: checks a pasted privacy policy for required items (purpose, items, retention, destruction, rights, privacy officer, safety measures, remedies, changes; plus cookies, outsourcing, third-party provision and overseas transfer when they apply; 제30조①, 시행령 제31조①) by keyword and lists what seems missing. Keyword check only; no filing or drafting.

contactUnknown.description: Some people cannot be contacted individually (breach)

hacking.description: Caused by unlawful external access such as hacking (breach)

knownAt.description: When the breach became known, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm (breach)

mode.description: breach = 72-hour clock, policy = privacy policy checklist

outsource.description: Outsources delivery, payment, hosting or support (policy)

sensitive.description: Sensitive data or unique identifiers such as resident numbers (breach)

website.description: Collects through a website or app, cookies (policy)

name: check_kr_privacy_breach_policy
title: check kr privacy breach policy
